Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Specifies the type of the Option whether it is a call option (right to purchase a specific underlying asset) or a put option (right to sell a specific underlying asset).

EmbeddedType.name: Embedded Type
EmbeddedType.definition: Specifies the type of the Option when an optional provision is embedded in the contract.

ExerciseStyle.name: Exercise Style
ExerciseStyle.definition: Indication as to whether the option may be exercised only at a fixed date (European, and Asian style), a series of pre-specified dates (Bermudan) or at any time during the life of the contract (American style). This field does not have to be populated for ISIN instruments.

ExerciseDate.name: Exercise Date
ExerciseDate.definition: Specifies the earliest unadjusted date during the exercise period on which an option can be exercised.

StrikePrice.name: Strike Price
StrikePrice.definition: Specifies the predetermined price at which the owner of the option can buy or sell the underlying instrument.||Usage: For foreign exchange options, specifies the exchange rate at which the option can be exercised as the rate of exchange from converting the unit currency into the quoted currency.|For volatility and variance swaps, specify the volatility strike price.

StrikePriceSchedule.name: Strike Price Schedule
StrikePriceSchedule.definition: Specifies the effective date and end date of the schedule for derivative transactions with strike prices varying throughout the life of the transaction.

CallAmount.name: Call Amount
CallAmount.definition: Indicates the amount and currency of a foreign exchange option that the option holder has the right to buy.

PutAmount.name: Put Amount
PutAmount.definition: Indicates the amount and currency of a foreign exchange option that the option holder has the right to sell.

PremiumAmount.name: Premium Amount
PremiumAmount.definition: Specifies the monetary amount of the premium paid by the buyer of the option.

PremiumPaymentDate.name: Premium Payment Date
PremiumPaymentDate.definition: Specifies the date on which the option premium is paid.

MaturityDateOfUnderlying.name: Maturity Date Of Underlying
MaturityDateOfUnderlying.definition: In case of swaptions, maturity date of the underlying swap.

BarrierLevels.name: Barrier Levels
BarrierLevels.definition: For a barrier option, specifies one or more barrier levels.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: At least one element must be present.
